policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This is a press Q&A document explaining the Interim Measures for Management of Anthropomorphic Interaction Services Using AI, jointly issued by five agencies. The measures take effect 2026-07-15. Scope is limited to persistent emotional interaction services; excludes customer service, Q&A, work assistants, education tools without persistent emotional interaction. Key focus areas: minors protection (under-14 requires guardian consent), elderly user safeguards, algorithm filing/registration, sandbox testing platform, and user dependency intervention obligations.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document primarily frames AI governance around protecting users—especially minors and the elderly—from harms such as emotional manipulation, addiction, self-harm, and privacy violations. The detailed provisions on intervention obligations, dependency warnings, and crisis response reinforce a consumer/public safety dominant frame. Secondary frames include fundamental rights (data rights, privacy, personal dignity), social stability (prohibitions on content threatening state security and social order), and innovation enablement (sandbox platforms, encouraging R&D).
